# Senzu Transport and Logistics

> Professional furniture removalists based in Brisbane, serving Brisbane, the Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast and South East Queensland. Safe, reliable and stress-free house moves, office relocations, packing and interstate removals. Fully insured.

## Services
- House Moves: Full home relocations throughout Brisbane and South East Queensland.
- Office Relocations: Fast and professional business relocations.
- Packing Services: Furniture wrapping, packing supplies and protection.
- Interstate Moves: Queensland, New South Wales and beyond.
- Packaging Removal: Removal of moving boxes and packaging waste.
- Furniture Delivery: Single furniture items and specialty deliveries.

## Service Areas
Brisbane, Gold Coast, Logan, Sunshine Coast, Ipswich, Toowoomba and surrounding South East Queensland areas.

## How It Works
1. Request a quote — tell us what you need moved.
2. Book your move — choose a time that suits you.
3. We pack & transport — our team handles everything with care.
4. You relax — your items arrive safely at your new home.
